name: jelaniwoodstv-site

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:e2e

//optionalDependencies: Media-authoring tools, needed only to regenerate assets in scripts/media — never to build or serve the site. They live here because their install steps reach outside npm: yt-dlp-exec's preinstall requires a Python interpreter, and ffmpeg-static downloads an ~80MB binary from GitHub. On a deploy image with no Python that preinstall aborts the entire install, which is exactly how the Railway build broke. Under optionalDependencies npm reports the failure and carries on, so a machine that has Python gets working media tooling and one that does not still ships the site.
